IVX HOLDINGS — ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION FINAL IMPLEMENTATION, MAPPING, DEEP QA, AND ZERO-KNOWN-ERROR CERTIFICATION

EXECUTE NOW. DO NOT ONLY REPORT OR CREATE A PLAN.

OBJECTIVE

Complete and verify enterprise registration across:

- IVX public landing page
- Expo Android application
- Expo iOS application
- Web application
- Backend APIs
- Supabase Authentication
- Production database
- Members module
- Enterprise module
- Investor and Buyer CRM
- Owner Dashboard
- Notifications
- Audit logs

Do not use mock users, test totals, placeholder success messages, or seeded production records.

“ZERO ERROR” MEANS:

- 0 known blocking defects
- 0 failed mandatory tests
- 0 silent failures
- 0 duplicate active identities
- 0 orphan authentication users
- 0 orphan member records
- 0 missing role records
- 0 false success responses
- 0 unauthorized privilege assignments
- 0 critical or high-severity security failures

==================================================
1. MAP THE COMPLETE REGISTRATION FLOW
==================================================

Document the actual production path:

USER
↓
LANDING PAGE / EXPO APP / WEB
↓
REGISTRATION FORM
↓
CLIENT VALIDATION
↓
BACKEND VALIDATION
↓
DUPLICATE CHECK
↓
SUPABASE AUTH IDENTITY
↓
EMAIL VERIFICATION
↓
PHONE VERIFICATION
↓
CANONICAL MEMBER RECORD
↓
REGISTRATION TYPE
↓
ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
↓
ENTERPRISE MEMBERSHIP
↓
KYC / AML / REVIEW STATUS
↓
CRM SYNCHRONIZATION
↓
OWNER DASHBOARD
↓
NOTIFICATIONS
↓
AUDIT LOG
↓
SUCCESS CONFIRMATION

For every stage return:

- Screen or route
- Exact source file
- API endpoint
- Backend service
- Database table
- Input
- Output
- Validation
- Error behavior
- Retry behavior
- Audit event
- Current production status
- Evidence

Allowed statuses:

- VERIFIED
- PARTIAL
- BLOCKED
- FAILED
- NOT IMPLEMENTED
- NOT VERIFIED

Do not invent missing files, routes, services, or database tables.

==================================================
2. ONE CANONICAL USER IDENTITY
==================================================

Every person must have one canonical identity.

Required core fields:

- auth_user_id
- member_id
- enterprise_id when applicable
- first_name
- last_name
- display_name
- normalized_email
- normalized_phone
- country_code
- primary_role
- secondary_roles
- registration_type
- registration_status
- email_verified_at
- phone_verified_at
- identity_status
- kyc_status
- aml_status
- owner_review_status
- source_channel
- data_origin
- terms_version
- privacy_version
- terms_accepted_at
- created_at
- updated_at
- audit_trace_id

Registration types:

- INDIVIDUAL
- ENTERPRISE
- INVESTOR
- BUYER
- JV_PARTNER
- TOKENIZED_INTEREST
- BROKER_AGENT
- LENDER
- VENDOR_CONTRACTOR
- TEAM_MEMBER

One person must not receive separate unrelated member identities for different roles.

==================================================
3. THREE-STEP REGISTRATION EXPERIENCE
==================================================

STEP 1 — ACCOUNT

Required:

- First name
- Last name
- Email
- Phone
- Password or approved passwordless method
- Terms acceptance
- Privacy acceptance

STEP 2 — PRIMARY ROLE

Allow one primary role:

- Investor
- Buyer
- JV Partner
- Tokenized Investment Interest
- Enterprise
- Broker or Agent
- Lender
- Vendor or Contractor

STEP 3 — PROFILE OR ENTERPRISE DETAILS

Individual fields:

- Profile picture optional
- City
- State
- ZIP/postal code
- Preferences related to the selected role

Enterprise fields:

- Legal company name
- Display company name
- Company type
- Industry
- Website
- Address
- Authorized representative
- Representative job title
- Team size
- Business category
- Required supporting documents

Required behavior:

- Maximum three screens
- Clear progress
- Back navigation without losing data
- Saved draft
- Field-level errors
- International phone formatting
- Password visibility control
- No loading loop
- No double submission
- Mobile keyboard does not cover fields
- Real confirmation ID after completion

==================================================
4. CLIENT AND SERVER VALIDATION
==================================================

Validate:

- Required fields
- Name length and characters
- Email format and normalization
- Phone format and normalization
- Country code
- Password policy
- Website format
- ZIP/postal code
- Company name
- Role selection
- Terms acceptance
- File type and size
- Duplicate identity
- Invitation validity
- Rate limits
- Suspicious repeated submissions

Rules:

- Client validation improves user experience.
- Server validation is authoritative.
- Invalid input must not create production records.
- Every rejection must have a safe error code and trace ID.
- No internal database or secret details may be shown to the user.

==================================================
5. EMAIL AND PHONE VERIFICATION
==================================================

EMAIL TESTS

- Verification message is sent
- Valid link or OTP succeeds
- Incorrect token fails
- Expired token fails
- Reused token fails
- Resend works
- Resend is rate-limited
- Email changes require re-verification
- Verified timestamp is stored

PHONE TESTS

- OTP is sent
- Correct OTP succeeds
- Incorrect OTP fails
- Expired OTP fails
- Reused OTP fails
- Retry limit works
- Resend delay works
- Phone changes require re-verification
- Verified timestamp is stored

Do not mark email or phone VERIFIED merely because the field exists.

==================================================
6. DUPLICATE PREVENTION
==================================================

Detect duplicates using:

- normalized_email
- normalized_phone
- auth_user_id
- verified company domain
- company registration identifier when available
- enterprise membership

Test variations:

- Uppercase and lowercase email
- Email spaces
- Phone punctuation
- Phone country-code variations
- Existing auth user without completed member record
- Existing member without correct role record
- Repeated button submission
- Simultaneous submissions

Required final values:

DUPLICATE ACTIVE IDENTITIES: 0
ORPHAN AUTH USERS: 0
ORPHAN MEMBERS: 0
UNRESOLVED TEST DUPLICATES: 0

Uncertain records must enter an owner review queue instead of being merged automatically.

==================================================
7. ROLE-SPECIFIC DATA MAPPING
==================================================

Create only the record required by the selected role.

INVESTOR

- member_id
- investment range
- property preferences
- geographic preferences
- accreditation status
- KYC status
- outreach consent

BUYER

- member_id
- purchase range
- target property types
- target areas
- financing status
- purchase timeline

JV PARTNER

- member_id
- contribution type
- available capital or services
- project preference
- geographic focus

TOKENIZED INTEREST

- member_id
- investment-interest range
- jurisdiction
- eligibility status
- risk acknowledgment

ENTERPRISE

- legal name
- display name
- company type
- website
- industry
- address
- authorized representative
- verification status
- team memberships

BROKER OR AGENT

- member_id
- brokerage
- license number
- license state
- verification status

LENDER

- member_id
- lending category
- minimum amount
- maximum amount
- states served
- licensing status

Do not create Investor, Buyer, JV, and Lender records for every user automatically.

==================================================
8. ENTERPRISE TEAM REGISTRATION
==================================================

Implement these enterprise roles:

- Enterprise Owner
- Enterprise Administrator
- Manager
- Analyst
- Contributor
- Read-only User
- External Advisor

Required controls:

- Single-use invitation
- Invitation expiration
- Enterprise ID binding
- Inviter identity
- Role assignment restrictions
- Domain or owner verification
- Membership audit history
- Suspension
- Removal
- Owner transfer
- Cross-enterprise isolation

Test:

- Valid invitation
- Expired invitation
- Reused invitation
- Modified invitation
- Wrong enterprise
- Unauthorized administrator assignment
- Non-admin invitation attempt
- Enterprise owner transfer
- Suspended member login
- Cross-enterprise access attempt

==================================================
9. KYC, AML, AND APPROVAL SEPARATION
==================================================

Required statuses:

- NOT_STARTED
- INFORMATION_REQUIRED
- SUBMITTED
- UNDER_REVIEW
- VERIFIED
- REJECTED
- EXPIRED
- MANUAL_REVIEW

Rules:

- Registration does not equal KYC approval.
- Email verification does not equal identity verification.
- Investor registration does not equal accreditation.
- Buyer registration does not equal proof of funds.
- Enterprise registration does not equal company verification.
- No financial privilege is granted before required checks pass.

==================================================
10. TRANSACTION-SAFE DATABASE CREATION
==================================================

Required registration sequence:

1. Validate request.
2. Normalize identity fields.
3. Check duplicates.
4. Create or recover Supabase Auth identity.
5. Create canonical member.
6. Create selected role record.
7. Create enterprise membership if required.
8. Save consent records.
9. Save verification state.
10. Create audit event.
11. Send notifications.
12. Return confirmation.

If any mandatory step fails:

- Do not display success.
- Roll back where supported.
- Record a recoverable state where rollback is impossible.
- Return a trace ID.
- Permit safe retry.
- Do not create duplicates during retry.

Force a failure at every step and verify recovery.

==================================================
11. DATABASE CONSTRAINTS AND INDEXES
==================================================

Verify or implement:

- Unique normalized email
- Unique auth_user_id
- Unique member-to-auth relationship
- Unique enterprise membership
- Unique invitation token
- Required foreign keys
- Required NOT NULL constraints
- Role constraints
- Status constraints
- Verification-token indexes
- Enterprise lookup indexes
- Registration timestamp indexes
- Audit trace indexes

Before migration:

- Back up production
- Review migration
- Test migration
- Create rollback
- Obtain owner approval for destructive changes

==================================================
12. RLS AND AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Verify:

- Public users can submit only approved registration fields.
- Users cannot assign themselves privileged roles.
- Users cannot mark email, phone, KYC, AML, or enterprise status verified.
- Users can read only permitted profile data.
- Enterprise users cannot access another enterprise.
- Only owner-authorized staff can approve an enterprise.
- Only owner-authorized staff can merge duplicates.
- Service-role credentials never enter the Expo or web client.
- Registrants cannot edit audit records.

Test direct API and direct database bypass attempts.

Required:

PRIVILEGE-ESCALATION FAILURES: 0
CROSS-ENTERPRISE ACCESS FAILURES: 0
CLIENT SECRET EXPOSURES: 0

==================================================
13. MEMBERS, CRM, AND OWNER DASHBOARD SYNC
==================================================

Every successful registration must appear in the correct production modules:

- Supabase Auth
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- JV Partners
- Tokenized Interest
- Enterprises
- Broker or Agent
- Lenders
- CRM
- Owner Dashboard
- Audit Logs

Return reconciliation:

AUTH USERS:
MEMBERS:
INVESTORS:
BUYERS:
JV PARTNERS:
TOKENIZED INTEREST:
ENTERPRISES:
ENTERPRISE MEMBERSHIPS:
BROKERS OR AGENTS:
LENDERS:
CRM RECORDS:
AUDIT EVENTS:

Every completed registration must reconcile with its required linked records.

==================================================
14. OWNER ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION CONTROL CENTER
==================================================

Required dashboard information:

- Registrations today
- Registrations this week
- Completed registrations
- Failed registrations
- Abandoned registrations
- Pending email verification
- Pending phone verification
- Pending enterprise review
- Pending KYC
- Duplicate-review queue
- Registrations by role
- Registrations by source
- Registrations by platform
- Conversion rate
- Error rate

Required owner controls:

- Search and filter
- Open registration
- Approve enterprise
- Reject enterprise
- Request more information
- Review documents
- Merge confirmed duplicate
- Disable account
- Resend verification
- Review audit trail
- Export approved records

Use only real production data.

==================================================
15. NOTIFICATION QA
==================================================

Verify:

- Registration confirmation
- Email verification
- Phone OTP
- Enterprise-review notice
- Request-for-information notice
- Enterprise approval
- Enterprise rejection
- Team invitation
- Invitation acceptance
- Owner notification for high-risk activity

For each notification verify:

- Correct recipient
- Correct template
- Delivery status
- No duplicate send
- Retry limit
- Failure handling
- Audit event
- No secret or sensitive-data exposure

==================================================
16. ERROR HANDLING
==================================================

Every failure must return:

- User-safe message
- Internal error code
- Trace ID
- Retryable: true/false
- Required next action
- Audit event

Test:

- Invalid input
- Duplicate email
- Duplicate phone
- Supabase Auth failure
- Database timeout
- Network loss
- Email-provider failure
- SMS-provider failure
- File-upload failure
- Enterprise creation failure
- Role-record failure
- Audit-write failure
- Notification failure
- Double submission
- App restart during registration
- Browser refresh during registration

Required:

SILENT FAILURES: 0
FALSE SUCCESS RESPONSES: 0
UNTRACEABLE FAILURES: 0

==================================================
17. LANDING PAGE QA
==================================================

Test:

- No layout jumping

- Owner dashboard visibility
- Slow network

Browsers:

- Edge

SECRET EXPOSURES: 0

CROSS-ENTERPRISE FAILURES: 0

==================================================
